apps.name: HomeRoll

apps.localizedDescription: An iPhone and iPad app for your own Immich server that looks and feels like Apple Photos: library with years, months and days, collections, memories, people, albums, folders, search, editing and automatic backup.

versions.localizedDescription:
## Fast scrolling and search fixes

- **Fast scroller in All**: when you scroll, a handle appears on the right. Grab it right away (no long press) and drag, a bubble shows month and year. Idea from @vands2013's fork.
- **Search**: the clear button in the search field is easier to hit and keeps the keyboard open, so you can type the next word right away (#49).
- **SideStore / AltStore source** (#50): add `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/silentprovider423/HomeRoll/main/sidestore.json` to get updates right in SideStore or AltStore.

## Light mode and Russian

- **Light mode** (#28): new Settings page (Library menu or account menu in Collections) with Automatic, Light and Dark. Automatic follows your iPhone. The whole app follows it: library, collections, albums, people, folders and search. The photo viewer, editor, info panel, memories player and slideshow stay dark so photos look their best. Thanks @RedEforIT for the groundwork.
- **Russian translation** of the app, widget and share extension. Thanks @awiqu.
- **Builds with Xcode 27** (#48). Thanks @PunditSharp.

## HomeRoll on iPad

- **Runs full screen on iPad** (#47) in all orientations, instead of the small iPhone window.
- **More columns on wide screens**: the photo grid keeps tiles about iPhone size, so you see 6 columns in portrait and 8 in landscape on an 11" iPad (iPhone landscape gets more columns too).
- **Years and months in two columns** on iPad, album headers and the bottom bar no longer stretch across the whole screen.
- Layout follows the window width, so it also fits when sharing the screen with another app.

A full iPad layout with a sidebar (like Photos on iPad) is planned for later.

## Folders, the way Photos shows them

- **Folders look like album folders in Photos** (#46): folders that contain folders show a 2x2 preview, the last folder in a chain shows up like an album with its cover photo. Bigger tiles, sort by name or date, and counts for one level only ("3 folders · 120 items").
- **Back button** inside the last folder instead of the close button (#46).
- **Search finds folder names** (#45). Folders with the same name show their parent folder, tap to open.
- **Years and Months switch instantly too** (#44): both stay loaded in the background like All, and the highlight fits around "Months" on every screen size.

## New: folders and a smoother library

- **Folders** in Collections (#42): browse your photos the way they're stored on the server, folder by folder. Made for external libraries with their own folder structure. Only shows up when your server has real folders – Immich's internal upload storage is hidden.
- **Years / Months / All switches instantly** (#37). The grid stays loaded in the background, so going back to All no longer lags, and the switcher's highlight is centered on each option.

Fixes from @PunditSharp – thank you:
- English names for categories, memory titles and edited files (#38)
- Edited photos and videos keep their capture time zone (#39)
- Backed-up edited photos no longer show as "processing" (#40)
- Editing a photo again in Apple Photos replaces the previous edit instead of adding another one (#41)
